question: Can I return a jacket I bought on clearance at 40% off?
reference: No refund: items bought at 30% off or more are final sale and can't be returned for a refund. It can be exchanged for a different size of the same item within 14 days, subject to stock.

question: How many days do I have to return something?
reference: 30 days from delivery for a full refund, if the item is unused, with tags attached and in its original packaging (Acme Trail Club members get 60 days on full-price items).

question: Do Trail Club members get a longer return window?
reference: Yes. Acme Trail Club members get an extended 60-day return window on all full-price items, instead of the standard 30 days.

question: I used my tent on a camping trip and don't like it. Can I get my money back?
reference: No. Gear that has been used outdoors can only be returned within 30 days if it is defective; used gear that isn't defective is not eligible for a refund.

question: Can I return an opened fuel canister?
reference: No. Opened fuel canisters and stove fuel are non-returnable.

question: How long until my refund shows up on my card?
reference: Refunds are issued within 5 business days after Acme receives and inspects the return; the bank may take another 3 to 7 business days to show the credit.

question: Do you refund the shipping cost when I return something?
reference: No, original shipping charges aren't refunded, except when the item was defective or Acme shipped the wrong item (EU customers withdrawing within 14 days also get the standard shipping charge back).

question: I live in Germany. What are my rights for returning an online order?
reference: EU customers have a statutory 14-day right of withdrawal on online orders, on top of the standard 30-day return window. Within those 14 days Acme refunds the item and the original standard shipping charge, even for sale items.

question: How much does a return shipping label cost?
reference: A return shipping label costs $6.95, deducted from the refund. Returning to any store is free.

question: How much is express shipping?
reference: Express shipping costs $19.00 (1 to 2 business days, in the United States).

question: What's the minimum order for free shipping?
reference: Standard shipping is free on orders over $75 (otherwise $7.95).

question: If I order at 3pm, when will it ship?
reference: Orders placed before 1 p.m. Mountain Time on a business day ship the same day; later orders ship the next business day. So a 3 p.m. order ships the next business day (assuming 3 p.m. Mountain Time).

question: Can you send bear spray to Hawaii?
reference: No. Bear spray can't ship to Hawaii (nor to Alaska or PO boxes); it ships by ground only and can't use Express.

question: Do you ship to Australia, and how much does it cost?
reference: Yes, Acme ships to Australia. International orders cost a flat $24.95 and take 7 to 14 business days; the customer pays any import duties and taxes on delivery.

question: My package says delivered but it's not here. What should I do?
reference: Wait 48 hours, then contact support@acme-outfitters.example. Acme reships lost or damaged orders free of charge once the carrier confirms the claim.

question: Can I cancel an order I placed an hour ago?
reference: No. Orders can only be changed or canceled within 30 minutes of being placed; after that the order is being packed and must be returned instead.

question: Is my Acme headlamp under warranty after 18 months?
reference: Yes. Acme electronics, including headlamps, have a two-year warranty, so a headlamp is still covered at 18 months (for defects in materials and workmanship).

question: How long is the warranty on Acme backpacks?
reference: Acme backpacks have a lifetime warranty against defects in materials and workmanship.

question: The zipper on my pack wore out. Will you fix it for free?
reference: No. Zippers and buckles that wear out after normal use are repaired for a flat $15 fee rather than for free.

question: How do I file a warranty claim without a receipt?
reference: Submit the claim at acme-outfitters.example/warranty with a photo of the defect. Without a receipt, Acme can look up purchases made with an Acme Trail Club account (the claim needs the order number or receipt otherwise).

question: How many vacation days do employees get?
reference: Full-time employees get 20 days of paid time off a year (part-time employees accrue PTO in proportion to their hours).

question: Can I carry over unused PTO into next year?
reference: Yes, up to 5 unused PTO days carry over into the next calendar year, and they must be used by March 31 or they expire.

question: How long is paid parental leave?
reference: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave (for employees with at least six months of service; taken at once or in blocks of at least two weeks within 12 months).

question: What discount do employees get on other brands?
reference: 20% off other brands (40% off Acme-branded products; for themselves and one household member; not combinable with sale prices or for resale).

question: What are Gear Days?
reference: Every employee gets two paid Gear Days a year to spend outdoors testing Acme products. They don't count against PTO and must be scheduled two weeks in advance.

question: How many days a week can corporate staff work from home?
reference: Corporate office employees can work remotely up to three days a week with manager approval.

question: How should I wash my down sleeping bag?
reference: Wash it in a front-loading washer on a gentle cycle with a down-specific detergent (not a top-loader with a center agitator), then tumble dry on low heat with two or three clean tennis balls; drying fully can take three to four hours.

question: Is it OK to store my tent while it's still damp?
reference: No. Always dry the tent completely before storing it; storing it damp for more than 24 hours can cause mildew and break down the waterproof coating.
